-- prelude.mms --
Type LangText = string | {string: string}
extern Template by_language(text: LangText?): {string: string}
extern Template english(text: LangText): string
-- 07-custom-item.mms -- design
-- items.mms --
CustomItem ruby {
  base = emerald
  name = "Ruby"
  texture = Texture("art/ruby.png")
}

CustomItem bell {
  base = gold_nugget
  name = { en_us = "Bell", de_de = "Glocke" }
  model = item/bell_model
  on_right_click = run {
    /playsound block.bell.use player @s
  }
}

CustomItem both {
  base = stick
  texture = Texture("a.png")
  model = item/x
  colour = 3
}

CustomItem nothing {
  name = "No base"
}
